title: Amazon Offers $900 Off 2026 16-Inch MacBook Pro With M5 Max Chip
excerpt: MacBook Pro deals have been getting steeper and steeper over the past few weeks, and today Amazon has introduced the biggest discount yet on one...
content_html:
MacBook Pro deals have been getting steeper and steeper over the past few weeks, and today Amazon has introduced the biggest discount yet on one model of the 16-inch MacBook Pro. You can get the M5 Max model with 36GB RAM and a 2TB SSD for $3,499.00, down from $4,399.00.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

This is a massive $900 markdown on the 2026 16-inch MacBook Pro, and the best price we've ever seen on this model of the computer. On Amazon, it's only available in Space Black, but you can find a matching deal at Best Buy in both color options.

Many of the best Mac-related deals have disappeared since Prime Day ended earlier in the month, but there are still some notable sales available online. The high-end 16-inch MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and a 2TB SSD is still available for $4,499.00 ($500 off), and many of the Mac mini and Mac Studio deals remain live.

If you're on the hunt for more discounts, be sure to visit our Apple Deals roundup where we recap the best Apple-related bargains of the past week.
